step_by_step_reasoning: The architecture diagram depicts a near real-time data ingestion, transformation, and analytics platform for Auction.com. Transactional data from Amazon RDS and external data ingested via Amazon AppFlow are stored in a raw Amazon S3 bucket. AWS Glue performs data transformation and applies business logic, writing the processed data into a second Amazon S3 bucket. Amazon Athena queries the processed data in S3 and serves query results directly to business analysts/data scientists and an executive/analytics dashboard UI.

graph.name: Auction.com Near Real-Time Analytics Architecture
graph.notes: Transitioned from nightly batch processing to near real-time querying for business analysts and data scientists using Athena and S3.

edges.notes: External data sources send data into Amazon AppFlow.
RDS exports transactional data to the raw S3 bucket.
AppFlow transfers external data directly into raw S3.
AWS Glue pulls raw data from S3 for processing.
AWS Glue outputs transformed data into the processed S3 bucket.
Athena queries data stored in the processed S3 bucket.
Athena serves query results to the dashboard UI.
Analysts and data scientists query Athena directly.
